[P2] Revisit the untested unknown-engine fallback

This violates Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” The only unknown-engine test asserts bare `.toThrow()`. Removing `?? STRICTEST` would still satisfy that assertion because accessing `dialect.mysqlComments` would throw a `TypeError`; known-engine tests never exercise the fallback. Consequently, the intended fallback behavior can disappear without a regression being detected. Return to the design phase under Rule 8 to decide whether unknown-engine support is necessary and establish its observable acceptance and refusal contract.
